Oracle._comment: Password never goes here. Set env var GBS_ORACLE_PASSWORD (or GBS_ORACLE_CONNECTION_STRING to override the whole string). Set GBS_ORACLE_TARGET=LOCAL|ADB_TLS|ADB_WALLET to pick which of DataSource/AdbHost+AdbServiceName/AdbTnsAlias applies; defaults to LOCAL.

AppLogin._comment: Password never goes here. Set env var GBS_APP_PASSWORD.
